verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents automatic prompt caching that requires no code changes and explicitly reduces effective token usage against rate limits, directly addressing latency/cost benefits for repeated context; rate-limit docs confirm cached tokens don't count toward uncached TPM limits, boosting throughput.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmarks confirming actual latency/cost reduction from caching, and no mention of cache TTL or hit-rate visibility tooling.
